author: evac
description: Role-holder daily photo-drop job: daily quota submissions, a streak, a strike system that controls a job role, PTO, and an automatic weekly Photo of the Week poll. The job role is the single source of truth for who can drop.
install_msg: Thanks for installing photodrop! Commands live under `.pp` or `.pockypolice`. The job role defaults to a hardcoded ID -- confirm it with `.pp set role @role`, then set `.pp set channel #channel` before anyone drops photos. `.pp hire @user` adds the role to get someone started.
short: Daily photo-drop job with a streak, a strike system, PTO, and a weekly photo poll.
